subject: general
question: Everything in this universe is made up of the following materials. Scientists name it:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Matter**__.

__
 
• Everything in this **universe** is made up of the following materials. Scientists name it **matter**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The** universe** is a collection of billions and **trillions** of stars and **galaxies**, along with **planets, asteroids, comets **and **clouds of dust**, and several **gases **all swirling in **space**.
 
• Everything in this **universe** is made up of **material **which is called** matter.** A matter is referred to as a substance that has a certain mass and takes up a certain** volume in space**.
 
 
• **For example**, we **human beings** are **matter** as well as a **pencil or a vehicle** is also a **matter**. So the matter is both a **living and a non-living thing**.
 
 
 
• The **matter** is composed of **atomic and subatomic** things (electron, proton, and neutron). Matter does not include** mass-less objects** like** light, photons, and sound.**
 
• **Matter exists** in different phases. The most common are **solid, liquid,** and **gaseous phases**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e8b211994306f907ad2137432a93efccdb6fbf041897d289b2efef7dce4a696.png]
